title: Arise, O God, Defend Your Cause

questions.question: O God, why do you cast us off forever? Why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:1 (ESV): "...Why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?"

questions.question: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:2 (ESV): "...which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your heritage!"

questions.question: Remember Mount Zion, where you have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:2 (ESV): "Remember Mount Zion, where you have dwelt."

questions.question: The enemy has damaged everything in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:3 (ESV): "...The enemy has damaged everything in the sanctuary."

questions.question: Your foes have roared in the midst of your meeting place; they set up their own signs for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:4 (ESV): "...they set up their own signs for signs."

questions.question: They set your sanctuary on fire; they profaned the dwelling place of your name, bringing it down to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:7 (ESV): "...bringing it down to the ground."

questions.question: We do not see our signs; there is no longer any prophet, and there is none among us who knows how what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:9 (ESV): "...and there is none among us who knows how long."

questions.question: How long, O God, is the foe to scoff? Is the enemy to revile your name when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:10 (ESV): "Is the enemy to revile your name forever?"

questions.question: Yet God my King is from of old, working salvation in the midst of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:12 (ESV): "...working salvation in the midst of the earth."

questions.question: You divided the sea by your might; you broke the heads of the sea monsters on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:13 (ESV): "...you broke the heads of the sea monsters on the waters."

questions.question: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him as food for the creatures of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:14 (ESV): "...you gave him as food for the creatures of the wilderness."

questions.question: Yours is the day, yours also the night; you have established the heavenly lights and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:16 (ESV): "...you have established the heavenly lights and the sun."

questions.question: Do not deliver the soul of your dove to the wild beasts; do not forget the life of your poor when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:19 (ESV): "...do not forget the life of your poor forever."

questions.question: Have regard for the covenant, for the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:20 (ESV): "...for the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence."

questions.question: Arise, O God, defend your cause; remember how the foolish scoff at you when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 74:22 (ESV): "remember how the foolish scoff at you all the day!"

key_verse_text: Yet God my King is from of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
